name: Susami (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Susami town emblem in navy: a stylised device of a pointed top and a disc, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Susami, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1962.

features.role: Susami town emblem — a stylised device of a pointed top and a disc, like a stylised character
